provenance.trialWindow: 亞洲第三批（南亞、阿拉伯半島、婆羅洲、帝汶、新幾內亞、澳門與廣州灣）1937-07-07～1945-09-02
provenance.dateSource: Australian War Memorial 115991／P01542.001／F07316：Labuan 1945-09-10, Lt Gen Masao Baba (37th Army, all Japanese forces in Borneo) surrendered to Maj Gen G. F. Wootten, 9th Australian Division

note.en: British protectorate administered by the North Borneo Chartered Company. [tail-1945-09c] Restored after the Labuan surrender (10 Sep 1945); pre-war geometry. Military administration noted only.
note.zh-Hant: 英國保護下由北婆羅洲渣打公司管理。1937-07-07 為本批起點，不是政權起日。 【tail-1945-09c】1945-09-10 納閩受降後恢復英屬北婆羅洲（幾何同戰前段）；澳軍／英軍軍政只寫在備註。古晉日軍 09-11 另行受降。
